checks.name: library placed in the Cube hall
six columns and four shelves hold 24 copies
repeated copies are distinct bodies sharing one edition mesh
last columns alter the same source rather than disguising new sources
authored meshes are batched into one geometry node per copy
production pickup moves one copy away from its shelf
released copy rests on the worktop
different prefab can join the new arrangement
two copies physically stack without passing through each other
visitor can walk along the full shelf

scope: Native museum render, supplied production pickup/release, separate instance state, shared meshes, collision and visitor-width access. Headset use remains untested.
